info.name: RescueBase — Integration Test Suite (INT-001 to INT-037)
info.description: Unified Postman integration testing suite covering all 37 cases (INT-001 through INT-037) across all 13 RescueBase system modules.

item.name: Step 1 - request OTP (set EMAIL and PASSWORD in the environment)

item.name: INT-029 Auth route rate limit (Runner: 301 iterations, delay 0). The last one must be 429

exec: if (pm.info.iteration >= 300) { pm.test('Request 301 is rate limited', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(429); }); } else { pm.test('Under the limit (not 429)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(429); }); }

item.name: INT-015 Step 3 Staff sees a possible match

exec: pm.test('A match exists for the two reports', function () { var m = pm.response.json().matches || []; var ids = [pm.collectionVariables.get('LOST_REPORT_ID'), pm.collectionVariables.get('FOUND_REPORT_ID')]; var hit = m.filter(function (x) { var a = (x.reportA && x.reportA._id) || x.reportA; var b = (x.reportB && x.reportB._id) || x.reportB; return ids.indexOf(String(a)) > -1 && ids.indexOf(String(b)) > -1; }); pm.expect(hit.length).to.be.above(0); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: base + path, method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
post('/api/auth/email/login', { email: email, password: password }, function (e1, r1) {
if (e1 || r1.code !== 200) { console.log('Applicant login failed', e1 || r1.code); return; }
post('/api/auth/email/verify-login-otp', { email: email, otp: otp }, function (e2, r2) {
if (e2 || r2.code !== 200) { console.log('Applicant OTP failed', e2 || r2.code); return; }
pm.sendRequest({ url: base + '/api/animals', method: 'GET' }, function (e3, r3) {
var j = r3.json(); var list = Array.isArray(j) ? j : (j.animals || []);
var a = list.find(function (x) { return x.adoptionStatus === 'available' && (!x.fosterStatus || x.fosterStatus === 'none'); });
if (a) pm.environment.set('TEST_FOSTER_ANIMAL_ID', a._id); else console.log('No available animal for the foster test');
